"""Publish comparison/viewer fixture evidence with no new model-quality claim."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

import psutil

REPO=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
ROOT=REPO/'.cache/quality-20261107/V178-phase-evidence-trial-v1'
V175=ROOT.parent/'V175-fresh-noise-matching-v2'
ADMISSION=ROOT.parent/'V178-phase-evidence-admission-v1'


def read(path):return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
def ref(path):
 path=Path(path).absolute()
 with path.open('rb') as stream:digest=hashlib.file_digest(stream,'sha256').hexdigest()
 return dict(path=str(path),sha256=digest)
def source(path):return dict(ref(path),text=Path(path).read_text())
def save(path,value):
 with Path(path).open('x') as stream:json.dump(value,stream,indent=2,allow_nan=False);stream.write('\n')


def main():
 draft=read(ROOT/'draft-v1.json');seal=read(ROOT/'report-source-v1.json')
 for path,digest in draft['frozen_files'].items():assert ref(path)['sha256']==digest
 for binding in draft['inputs']:assert ref(binding['path'])==binding
 assert len(draft['frozen_files'])==713 and len(draft['inputs'])==9
 helpers=[]
 for binding in seal['helpers']:
  path=Path(binding['path']);assert ref(path)==binding
  canonical=REPO/path.relative_to(ROOT/'report-work-v1')
  assert path.read_bytes()==canonical.read_bytes()
  helpers.append(dict(binding,text=path.read_text(),canonical=ref(canonical)))
 audit_seal=read(ROOT/'audit-source-v1.json')
 for binding in audit_seal['helpers']:assert ref(binding['path'])==binding
 tests=read(ROOT/'report-source-v1.json')['CPU_tests'];assert '14 passed' in tests['text']
 assert ref(tests['path'])=={k:tests[k] for k in ['path','sha256']}
 comparison=read(ROOT/'comparison-fixture-verification-v2.json')
 assert comparison['methods']==13 and comparison['reused_metric_rows']==10686
 assert comparison['contrasts']==34 and comparison['fixture_paired_groups']==4470
 assert comparison['independent_Decimal_summary_means']==1757 and comparison['paired_mean_and_difference_checks']==13410
 assert comparison['table_cells_independently_formatted_with_Decimal']==714
 assert comparison['matched_fixture_differences_all_zero'] and comparison['actual_new_quality_rows']==0
 for key in ['fixture_result','fixture_tables']:
  assert ref(comparison[key]['path'])==comparison[key]
 assert Path(comparison['fixture_tables']['path']).read_text().startswith('# CPU COMPARISON FIXTURE')
 pixels=read(ROOT/'viewer-fixture-pixels-v1.json');build=read(ROOT/'viewer-fixture-build-v1.json')
 assert pixels['browser_crop_screenshots']==480 and pixels['RGB_channels_exact_source_PNG']==36864000
 assert pixels['JS_errors']==[] and pixels['fixture_only_no_actual_V178_quality']
 assert len(build['rejected_invalid_manifests'])==4 and build['actual_new_model_forwards']==0
 assert ref(pixels['viewer']['path'])==pixels['viewer'] and ref(pixels['manifest']['path'])==pixels['manifest']
 assert read(pixels['manifest']['path'])['fixture'] is True
 entry=read(ROOT/'report-frozen-entry-v1.json');assert not entry['Torch_imported'] and not entry['actual_V178_results']
 assert entry['reducer']==seal['reducer'] and entry['viewer']==seal['viewer']
 baseline=read(V175/'plan-v1.json')
 for name,digest in baseline['prior_neural_hashes'].items():assert ref(REPO/'src/demosaic'/name)['sha256']==digest
 neural=list((REPO/'src/demosaic').glob('*.py'));assert len(neural)==97
 for path in neural:assert path.read_bytes()==(Path(draft['work'])/'src/demosaic'/path.name).read_bytes()
 post=read(V175/'postprocess-inputs-v1.json');assert len(post['helpers'])==18
 for binding in post['helpers']:assert ref(binding['path'])==binding
 assert (REPO/'scripts/build_native_crop_viewer.py').read_bytes()==(Path(draft['work'])/'scripts/build_native_crop_viewer.py').read_bytes()
 owners=[]
 for folder,launch,status in [(V175,'train-launch-v1.json','train-status-v1.json'),
   (V175,'completion-watch-launch-v1.json','completion-watch-status-v1.json'),
   (ADMISSION,'watch-launch-v1.json','watch-status-v1.json'),(ROOT,'controller-launch-v1.json','controller-status-v1.json')]:
  owner=read(folder/launch)['owner'];process=psutil.Process(owner['pid'])
  assert process.create_time()==owner['created'] and process.status() not in ['dead','zombie']
  assert not list(folder.glob('*failure-v1.json'))
  owners.append(dict(root=str(folder),owner=owner,status=read(folder/status)))
 for name in ['plan-v1.json','scores-v1.json','paired-comparisons-v1.json','comparison-tables-v1.md','control-train-launch-v1.json','evidence-train-launch-v1.json']:
  assert not (ROOT/name).exists(),name
 public=REPO/'docs/results/v178-matched-comparison-viewer-preparation-v1.json'
 stamp=datetime.datetime.now(ZoneInfo('America/Los_Angeles')).isoformat()
 save(public,dict(status='pass-frozen-matched-report-and-native-viewer-fixtures-no-actual-V178-quality',
  recorded_local=stamp,source_seal=seal,exact_helper_sources=helpers,
  comparison_fixture= comparison,viewer_build_fixture=build,actual_browser_pixel_fixture=pixels,
  frozen_entry_checks=entry,CPU_tests=tests,
  preserved_preparation_rejections=dict(
   first_test_log=source(REPO/'.cache/v178-comparison-CPU-tests-v1.log'),
   first_test_source=source(REPO/'.cache/test-phase-evidence-comparisons-v1.py'),
   correction='Test fixture expectation incorrectly applied evidence increment to control contrasts;corrected by method.12passed/1failed then13passed;adding alias regression yields14passed.',
   first_full_fixture_log=source(REPO/'.cache/v178-comparison-fixture-v1.log'),
   first_reducer_source=source(REPO/'.cache/v178-comparison-reducer-v1.py'),
   alias_correction='Older parent has original crop_DC_RMS_DN16 without later duplicate quiet_DC_RMS_DN16. Common original DC field stays mandatory;old scores unchanged. First fixture stopped before a result. v2 succeeds without new model work.'),
  actual_layout_viewing=dict(screenshot=ref(ROOT/'viewer-browser-fixture-v1/screen-first.png'),
     viewed=True,scope='First browser screenshot actually viewed at original detail for layout only. Marked CPU fixture,no V178 quality viewing.'),
  observed_live_owners=owners,
  GiB_available=dict(RAM=psutil.virtual_memory().available/2**30,local=shutil.disk_usage(REPO).free/2**30,external=shutil.disk_usage('/mnt/external').free/2**30),
  actual_new_V178_forwards=0,actual_V178_trial_updates=0,actual_V178_quality_rows=0,
  scope='Three additive report/viewer/test files;original713 trial andtwo audit files unchanged. All synthetic method names explicitly reuse old values/pixels;no new performance/native comparison is published. Real future results require completed owners/audits and actual viewing. No new external artifacts or original-media work.',
  publisher=source(__file__)))
 docs=[REPO/name for name in ['README.md','docs/phase-evidence-training.md','docs/index.md','docs/experiments.md',
       'diary/2026-11-07-21-38-58-phase-evidence-matched-comparisons-viewer.md']]
 links=0
 for path in docs:
  for link in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',path.read_text()):
   if link.startswith(('http:','https:','mailto:','#')):continue
   assert (path.parent/link.split('#')[0]).resolve().exists(),(path,link)
   links+=1
 save(REPO/'docs/results/v178-matched-comparison-viewer-publication-verification-v1.json',dict(
  status='pass-report-viewer-source-fixture-publication-and-live-owner-checks',recorded_local=stamp,
  preparation=ref(public),documents=[ref(path) for path in docs],local_links_checked=links,
  trial_frozen_files=713,trial_immutable_inputs=9,additive_audit_helpers=2,additive_report_helpers=3,
  current_neural_sources_unchanged=97,prior_V175_neural_sources_unchanged=96,sealed_V175_helpers_unchanged=18,
  CPU_comparison_tests=14,reused_rows_in_fixture=10686,fixture_table_cells=714,
  browser_fixture_crops=480,exact_fixture_browser_RGB_channels=36864000,
  observed_live_owners=owners,new_model_forwards=0,new_sensor_draws=0,actual_V178_quality_rows=0,
  source=source(__file__),scope='Publication verification only;hashes and owner checks. Existing CPU fixture/prototype failures remain preserved. No new scientific model result,quality viewing or gain is claimed.'))
 print('PASS713+2+3files/input9/neural97/helper18/CPU14/714cells/480browsercrops/links',links,flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':main()

scope: Publication verification only;hashes and owner checks. Existing CPU fixture/prototype failures remain preserved. No new scientific model result,quality viewing or gain is claimed.
